prompt: Saponification: ethyl benzoate + NaOH (aq.), heat; then acidic workup. Draw the organic product.
explanation: Ester + hydroxide → carboxylate + alcohol (irreversible — resonance-stabilized carboxylate anion is the thermodynamic sink). Acidic workup protonates to free carboxylic acid. Also makes ethanol as byproduct.
